card.name: Linking word after 'the period'
card.fires_on: The word right after 'the period' or 'the years' that opens a time span, mostly 'from', 'between' or 'before'. It also fires on 'period' itself after 'covers the'.

modes.label: Span-opening word
modes.description: A linking word such as from, between or before that follows 'period' and starts a date or time range.
modes.example: These maps cover the period<< from>> the French colonial era of the seventeenth

modes.label: Years or period itself
modes.description: A word in a phrase about a span of years, such as 'years immediately' or 'the period'.
modes.example: Orthodox Churches in the years<< immediately>> following the war.
